metadata.case_name: WONG TSAN MING v. TSE CHI MAN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Sole-proprietor of a decoration and construction company specializing in painting work (W.M. Company)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Assistant in a friend's Classical Curtain Company; unemployed before conclusion of hearing

injuries.description: He also had abrasions at the elbows.
source: He also had abrasions at the elbows.

injuries.description: His right tibia plateau (as shown on the x-ray) was fractured.
source: His right tibia plateau (as shown on the x-ray) was fractured.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified fracture of upper end of tibia

injuries.description: treated with a course of antibiotics for the severe soft tissue crush injury and persistent fever after the operation.
injuries.body_part: right lower limb / local soft tissue
source: treated with a course of antibiotics for the severe soft tissue crush injury and persistent fever after the operation.

manifestations.description: felt severe pain at his limbs, particularly at his right leg
discomfort of stiffness, pain, and weakness at the right knee especially when negotiating stairs
walked with a very noticeable limp
articular congruity of the knee joint was not perfectly reconstituted
premature knee joint osteoarthritis of his right knee (anticipated)
knee joint was grossly deformed and the knee joint was not normal (post-implant removal comment by Dr. Shen)
general sense of discomfort over his right lower limb after walking for about half an hour on level ground; stiffness on the first few steps after sitting for some time; no pain at rest

treatments_received: use of Exogen machine at home

losses.description: Fracture of the right tibia plateau with residual knee dysfunction and possibility of future total knee replacement
Walks with a noticeable limp, cannot climb stairs easily, tires easily and has reduced walking endurance
Unable to continue pre-accident decoration painting business; worked as assistant in a curtain company
